title: Unbounded derived sections of modules over an open
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and $U\subseteq X$ open. The category $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the category $\operatorname{Ab}$ admit K-injective resolutions [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Define $R\Gamma(U,-):D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\operatorname{Ab})$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] as the unbounded right derived functor of the sections functor $\Gamma(U,-)$ [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], computed by K-injective resolutions: for a K-injective representative $I^\bullet$ it is represented by the complex of termwise sections $\Gamma(U,I^\bullet)$. Define $H^m(U,K)=H^m(R\Gamma(U,K))$ for every $m\in\mathbf Z$.
